title: ProFTPD through 1.3.9e and 1.3.10rc1 through 1.3.10rc4 contains a link-following vulnerability in mod_copy that allows…
description: ProFTPD versions through 1.3.9e and 1.3.10rc1 through 1.3.10rc4 have a vulnerability in the mod_copy module that allows authenticated FTP users to bypass write restrictions by exploiting symbolic links. This enables attackers to overwrite files in locations where write access is normally denied by placing symlinks in writable directories and using SITE COPY or SITE CPTO commands.
